Sam (docs): quick q — our migration-guide PR is blocked by the docs-preview check even though it's just markdown and an example snippet. any way to avoid waiting 20m for the preview for tiny docs-only edits? :grimacing:

Priya (eng): which check is blocking? ci-bot should mark docs-preview optional for markdown-only changes if configured.

Sam (docs): `docs-preview` is the failing status. It always runs and is required by branch protection. I was hoping we could either: (a) make it optional for `docs/**` and `website/**`, or (b) have a fast-path that skips full preview when only `.md` changes.

Jonah (devex): +1 to fast-path. We already use pathfilters in GH Actions; we can make the heavy preview job conditional. Example in workflow:```yaml
jobs:
  docs-preview:
    if: contains(github.event.head_commit.message, '[docs-preview]') || (github.event.pull_request.changed_files > 0 && !startsWith(join(github.event.pull_request.files, ','), 'nonexistent'))
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps: ...
```
But that placeholder is messy. Better: use `paths`/`paths-ignore` at workflow level so the job won't run for non-doc changes.

Priya (eng): We also need to update branch-protection. Required checks can be set to 'required unless PR only touches docs'. GitHub doesn't support conditional required checks natively. Two options:
- Use a lightweight required check (e.g., `docs-skim`) that runs fast and verifies only MD diff, and then gate the heavy preview with optional status.
- Keep `docs-preview` required but change workflow to exit fast (pass) on MD-only changes.

Sam (docs): I like the lightweight `docs-skim` idea. it could run in <30s and confirm only docs changed and basic link sanity. If heavy preview is optional, maintainers can still run it when needed.

Jonah (devex): I'll draft a tiny GH action that inspects the PR files and either returns success (skips) or triggers full preview. Pseudocode:```bash
changed=$(jq -r '.pull_request.files[].filename' <<< "$GITHUB_EVENT")
if printf "%s\n" "$changed" | grep -vE '\\.(md|png|svg)$' > /dev/null; then
  echo "non-doc changes detected"
  # run preview
else
  echo "docs-only: fast-pass"
  exit 0
fi
```
We can name the fast check `docs-skim` and keep it very permissive.

Priya (eng): sounds good. small caveat: the site build can still catch broken snippets (code fences) that only run in preview. if we fast-pass, we lose that guard. maybe `docs-skim` should run a link-check and search for fenced-block markers like `<!-- runnable-example -->` and fail if present, forcing preview.

Sam (docs): perfect — we mark example snippets that need preview with `<!-- requires-preview -->` and authors add that comment to the PR if they update runnable examples. docs-skim will fail on that marker.

Jonah (devex): will implement: 
- new action `docs-skim` (fast) that: checks changed files, runs link-check for md, scans for `requires-preview` marker, exits non-zero if markers found.
- keep `docs-preview` workflow but mark it optional in branch protection (so it can be run manually or by CI when needed).
- update CODEOWNERS note so doc owners are aware.

Sam (docs): any CODEOWNERS changes needed? right now `CODEOWNERS` has `docs/* @docs-team`. If we add the `requires-preview` marker rule, we should update CONTRIBUTING.md.

Priya (eng): no CODEOWNERS tweak required for the automation itself, but add a short line to CONTRIBUTING: "If you edit runnable examples, add <!-- requires-preview --> to the file so CI will run a full preview."

Sam (docs): can someone open the devex PR for the GH action and a tiny CONTRIBUTING update? I can review/docs side.

Jonah (devex): I'll open PR after lunch. PR will include: ` .github/workflows/docs-skim.yml` + update to `CONTRIBUTING.md`. Will tag @Priya for review on the action and @Sam for content.

ci-bot: PR #4382 opened by Jonah: `devex: add docs-skim fast check + contributing note` — checks: docs-skim (pending), lint (ok)

Sam (docs): thanks! i'll look later today. if folks agree we can roll this change to unblock small docs PRs but still keep safety for runnable examples. :thumbsup: 

Priya (eng): SGTM. tiny follow-up: add a short test to the action unit so we don't regress.

Jonah (devex): will add tests. I'll ping here when PR is ready for final review.

Sam (docs): awesome, this should cut our merge time for docs-only fixes from ~20m to <1m in most cases. :tada:
